defects.observed: Each card is 238px tall but its content (icon + heading + 2-line sentence) is top-aligned and occupies only the upper ~45%; roughly 110-130px of empty white space sits at the bottom of all four cards, making the grid look unbalanced and the cards oversized for their content.
defects.required: A 2x2 grid of four reason cards that reads as a deliberate, balanced presentation layout.

defects.observed: The 'No Market Need' icon is a bullseye/target (three concentric circles). A bullseye conventionally signals 'on target / hitting the market', the opposite sentiment of the failure reason it labels.
defects.required: Each inline SVG icon should match the sentiment of its reason (icon-sentiment match).

defects.observed: Two icons touch the SVG viewBox boundary exactly: the users glyph strokes run to x=1 and x=23 with stroke-width 2 (outer edge lands on x=0/x=24), and the dollar-sign line runs y=1 to y=23 with round caps landing on y=0/y=24. Rendered output shows no clipping at 44px, but there is zero margin, so the glyphs sit flush to their box with antialiasing right at the edge.
defects.required: SVG renders correctly with no clipped or edge-touching shapes.

summary: Prompt requirements are all met literally: exactly 4 reason cards in a true CSS 2x2 grid (grid-template-columns/rows 1fr 1fr), each with an inline SVG icon, a 26px bold heading, and exactly one supporting sentence; footer shows '7' bottom-right; no overflow (scrollW/H 1280x720, overflows:false), no console errors, no invented text or extra reasons. Body text is 20px (at the minimum legibility threshold) with strong contrast (#3a4258 on #ffffff). Icons are clean Feather-style glyphs with no stray strokes or artifacts. Defects are limited to visual polish: large dead space in the lower half of every card, a bullseye icon whose sentiment reads as success rather than failure, and two glyphs whose strokes sit flush against the viewBox edge.
